**Note:** The scalar schema cannot list every co-occurring pool value on one mode. Per the datasheet, **SFF-8431 / SFF-8432 / SFF-8472**, **FE / GbE / STM / FC / CPRI / OBSAI**, and **0.1 / 1.25 Gbps** all apply to every part in the same technical sections; only **model (channel)** differs by ordering row. Extra modes for interface × rate × protocol combinations are not supported by separate table rows. If your pipeline expects full pool coverage, add companion **family-level** modes on `SO-SFP-L80D-50G-Dxxxx` for the remaining `host_interface_name`, `standards_code`, and `bit_rate_gbps` values that co-occur in the global protocol/MSA rows.
